text:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: Alert fired — service=runtime-p95-latency, severity=high, incident=PD-17422

incident-bot: Auto-page triggered: threshold breach (p95 > 300ms for 3m). Linked runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/runtime-latency

alex: acked — looking

maria: i'm seeing a short spike across the us-west cluster dashboards, 3m window shows p95 ~420ms, cpu on a couple nodes jumped at the same time. no obvious 5xx spike from quick glance

siva: is this the traffic surges from the nightly indexing job? i see a correlation with a cron at 23:41 UTC in conf/jobs 

alex: not the indexing job, this came at 23:07 UTC. checking autoscaling events and node events now

jen: system alerts also show kubelet evictions on node-gpu-14 around the same minute 

maria: past 1 minute we had a bunch of small retries — could be tail-latency from noisy hosts + cache thrash. small % of requests retried, ~0.8% error/retry rate on the sample traces

alex: running quick query for recent autoscaler events:
```
kubectl get hpa -n platform runtime-hpa -o yaml | grep -n "lastScale" -A3
# found two scale-down events 2m and 5m before spike
```

siva: that smells like scale-down followed by sudden traffic bump -> KCold starts + KV cache warmup -> p95 blips. if we can delay scale-down or pin min replicas during peak window same mitigation

maria: for immediate mitigation i can bump minReplicas to 6 for the runtime pool. that should smooth the next few minutes. will also add a short 5m cooldown on the HPA per runbook quick fix

alex: please do it and post the commands you run

maria: running:
```
kubectl patch hpa runtime-hpa -n platform --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/minReplicas","value":6}]'
kubectl annotate hpa runtime-hpa -n platform redwood.io/temp-patch=autoscale-cooldown-5m
```

incident-bot: Action logged by maria — temporary HPA minReplicas increased to 6, annotation added.

pagerduty-bot: Alert auto-resolved — service=runtime-p95-latency, incident=PD-17422 (duration 6m)

alex: confirmed dashboards trending back to normal p95 ~120ms, error rate unchanged. nice quick mitigation.

jen: i still see two nodes that had kubelet churn, filing ticket to investigate underlying node health (non-urgent)

siva: for customer impact: from sampled traces, ~3% requests experienced >300ms p95, <0.05% 5xx. no major customer-facing outages, but some increased latency for chat/autocomplete flows during the spike window

alex: thanks — i'll take a quick handoff writeup for next shift. @oncall-night you'll take follow-up on the node ticket and confirm whether we should pin minReplicas for the next 24h

oncall-night: ack — will pick up, check node health + any remedial kubelet config. will also loop in infra team if we see repeat evictions

maria: creating short incident note in #incidents and adding timeline + mitigation. postmortem not required unless this repeats in 24h.

alex: follow-ups:
- infra: check node-gpu-14 kubelet/kernel logs (jen)
- runtime: evaluate HPA cooldown and consider workload-aware window during known peaks (siva)
- ops: add heartbeat check to detect rapid scale-down+spike combos (maria)

maria: link to brief notes: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1905001122/notes (private)

alex: closing thread — pagerduty auto-resolved and mitigation applied. leaving open for handoff to oncall-night for follow-up. thanks all :thumbsup:
